data.title: 丛雨 · 风口按住两张草药签
data.description: 晨风把种植架上的两张药草签吹离原处。丛雨站到木桌前，用书角压住一张，再伸手够另一张。白纱披巾松搭在衣肩，晨光透过最薄的边缘，里面仍是遮得严整的白棉日常连衣裙。
data.action: 用书角压住一张草药签，伸手抓住另一张
data.lighting: 淡晨光透亮披巾边沿，木桌保留柔和阴影
data.camera: 平视斜侧中景，带到桌上纸签
data.promptProse: A morning gust lifts two labels from the herb table. Murasame pins one label with the corner of a book and reaches out for the other. Her open white silk-gauze wrap lies loosely over the shoulders of a fully opaque white cotton day dress. Only the fine outer hem of the wrap glows in the sunlight.
data.animaCaption: The book holds one label flat while her other hand catches the one lifting off the table.
